mapper.select: SELECT id,toilet_code AS toiletCode,name,address,district,open_time AS openTime,created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_toilet ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT r.id,r.toilet_id AS toiletId,t.name AS toiletName,r.fault_desc AS faultDesc,r.reporter,r.status,r.created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_repair_order r JOIN tb_toilet t ON t.id=r.toilet_id ORDER BY r.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_repair_order SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.toilet_id AS toiletId,t.name AS toiletName,c.consumable_name AS consumableName, c.current_stock AS currentStock,c.min_stock AS minStock, (CASE WHEN c.current_stock < c.min_stock THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS lowStock FROM tb_consumable_stock c JOIN tb_toilet t ON t.id=c.toilet_id ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_toilet) AS toiletCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM toilet_feedback) AS feedbackCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_repair_order WHERE status != 'FINISHED') AS repairPendingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_consumable_stock WHERE current_stock < min_stock) AS lowStockCount
